device.description: 10-bit 2 MSPS reconfigurable ADC (4/8/10-bit), 4 single-ended / 2 differential inputs, dual S/H, parallel interface, power down
device.note: tlv1562.pdf (SLAS162) p.1 pinout, p.4 terminal functions, p.5 control registers CR0/CR1 and input/output data formats (Figure 1), p.6 Table 1 channel select and register read-back, p.7 programming examples, p.12 Table 2 conversion trigger edges and times, p.13-18 conversion modes, p.18-19 SYSCLK source, output data format, power down, p.25 recommended operating conditions, p.27 timing requirements (tconv), p.29 internal OSC, tdis/ten(DATAOUT), INT timing

registers.name: CR0
registers.note: p.5 Figure 1: written with index D(9,8) = 00; reset value not given (0 here)

registers.name: CR1
registers.note: p.5 Figure 1: written with index D(9,8) = 01; D7 and D3 are 0; reset value not given (0 here)

commands.name: Write CR0
commands.note: p.5: D(9,8) = 00 index, D(7..0) = CR0 (OMS, clock select, input type, conversion mode, channel select)

commands.name: Write CR1, software power down
commands.note: p.5, p.6, p.19: CR1.0 = 1 enters software power down; the next two RD rising edges read CR0 then CR1 (index in D(9,8), content in D(7..0))

commands.name: Write CR1
commands.note: p.5, p.19: CR1.0 = 0 wakes the device (conversions can start 1 us later)

pages: p.1 (pinout, DW/PW), p.4 (terminal functions), p.5 (CR0/CR1, Figure 1 data formats), p.6 (Table 1, register read-back in power down), p.7 (examples), p.12 (Table 2 triggers, conversion times), p.13-18 (conversion modes), p.18-19 (SYSCLK, output format, power down), p.25 (ROC: AVDD/DVDD/BDVDD 2.7-5.5 V), p.27 (tconv1/tconv2), p.29 (internal OSC 7.5 MHz min, tdis 10 ns, ten 41 ns at BDVDD 2.7 V / 50 pF)
notModeled: analog inputs, references, single-ended / differential input type (CR0.IT, stored only) and the dual S/H: every conversion returns the 0 V code; in differential mode with binary output (CR1.2 = 1) the 0 V code is mid-scale 512 (bipolar offset), the model returns 0 (codeFormat follows CR1.FMT only)

conversion modes (CR0.MS): mono/dual interrupt-driven and mono/dual continuous are stored only and select the conversion time; every RD read and every CSTART rising edge starts one single conversion. RD-vs-CSTART trigger selection (CR1.6) is not enforced; continuous-mode pipelining (1 to 3 RD delays, two-deep FIFO in dual continuous mode, p.13, p.18) and the second result of dual modes are not modeled
conversion start edges: the datasheet starts on RD falling (data of the previous conversion released) or CSTART rising (sampling from CSTART falling); the model starts at the end of the RD read
conversion time uses the internal SYSCLK at its 7.5 MHz minimum (p.29) for every setting; external CLKIN (1-15 MHz, CR0.5 = 1) is not modeled
INT: goes low at the end of conversion and is released by RD or CS rising (p.4); the model releases it on the next read or start (CS rising alone does not release it)

software power down register read-back (p.6): CR0 then CR1 on the next two RD rising edges; modeled as CR0 on the first read after the power-down write, then CR1 on every further read until CR1.0 is cleared
auto power down (CR1.1) wake-up delays (700 ns / 1 us), the 1 us resume time after software power down, and the 200 ns entry delay after CS rises
mid-scale error calibration modes (CR0.OMS = 01 / 10) and the calibration register: stored only
the TLV1562 data bus D(0-9) and CS/OE output-enable in CSTART interrupt modes (data enabled by CS alone): the model drives data only during CS and RD active
variants: Single device on this datasheet (C and I grades).
